doc.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Thanks and wrap-up
summary: Both thank Rowe for the opportunity and praise the jazz community.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’d like to say that I want to thank you enormously for the opportunity you’ve given us because we feel that this is a message that many generations we hope will enjoy and take something from and be inspired by, and we thank you so much for giving us the opportunity and I thank you Jackie for joining.
Well I enjoyed sitting with you as well. Thank you very much.
Well it’s got to be something about the music because the people I’ve met that are associated with jazz have just been the classiest group, so on that note—
